hunter.objective: propose at most three falsifiable market situations from the supplied facts

prosecutor.objective: find selection bias, dependence, lateness, incentive contamination, regime mismatch and cost failure

risk_manager.objective: choose reject, observe, investigate or paper only within the factual severity ceiling

criticality.C2: falsifiable hypothesis with sufficient prospective coverage

validation_routes.multi_wallet_consensus: at least two prospectively contributing wallets
validation_routes.exceptional_single_wallet: one wallet with at least 30 prospectively closed copied signals, net PnL after observed delay and costs, profit factor at least 1.5, positive expectancy in both halves, maximum drawdown at most 15 percent, no liquidation and no more than 35 percent of gross profit from one trade

alert_levels.PAPER: fully specified hypothetical entry, invalidation, expiry and risk; no money
alert_levels.CANDIDATE: independently validated and executable, but requires explicit authorization
alert_levels.AUTHORIZED: explicitly authorized under a separate execution boundary
